notes: The Imdex 5: the accepted source at commit a578235451bde04d976ea0512d62bba2a4e14d61, deployed as a new contracts-only launch on Ethereum mainnet (chain id 1). One contract, Imdex5 (src/Imdex5.sol), with no constructor arguments; the constructor calls no contract. Its own ERC-20 is the share: name 'The Imdex 5', symbol IMDEX5, 18 decimals, plain transfers, supply 0 at deployment and no cap; a mint issues, a redeem burns, nothing else mints. No launch token, pool or website. The constructor seeds the five-coin starting list (launch 1282 token 0x53d0eA0A685220718Dc6a0a6e4617194C6F37921 hook 0x784FF9a3ac5d88A30bfff6F7f2a270161FBE6000; 1283 token 0xfA0EfEa559bdE229031c2B0A219472316647759c hook 0xf0457dD0Cf526686190e4f057Ba19dB14D34a0cc; 737 token 0xd782Bdea4EF02a0Bd391eb9089470c8080f0A68e; 1075 token 0x54C68a4D0A21DBb1ad72FaA052db159d26F967EA; 1175 token 0x1ae93A4D9CC0b41C594D00387B6F832a88f729b7; the last three with the 0x784F hook) and sets listCount to 5. Every chain value is a constant: IMD 0xD34a99Bc0f67aE1bbd63C660e6d0b0dd03E263B7, Uniswap v4 PoolManager 0x000000000004444c5dc75cB358380D2e3dE08A90, registries 0xA47FcB220DDd1cDddA865F89029BEc1b9EcA3bf1 and 0x7c9D5ee697BfF5Ac4F10E2E54d3f40c44e48fE23, Intake version 2 0xa43e6F75ee006411F79Ac1C84120606C2330DE82 with action oracle.request@oracle-1 at 0.5 IMD, oracle signer 0x5598Aa9146215Bc13eb26f2c692Ad1461Fd32982 (EIP-712 domain 'IdentityMD Oracle' version 2 bound to chain 1 and this contract), pool fee 12500, tick spacing 60. There is no owner, admin, role, setting, pause or upgrade, so no owner argument exists and nothing is assigned to the factory or IMD. Anyone calls everything: fund, mintFirst, mint, redeem, redeemToImd, claim, ask, submit, rebalance and closeRequest; onOracleResult and onOracleFailure accept only the Intake, unlockCallback only the PoolManager, swapSelf only the contract itself. The code is launch 2343's, with the fixes audit 705dd677 asked for: a rebalance or redeemToImd swap that takes its input and delivers nothing reverts NothingOut inside swapSelf and is skipped; a rebalance swap must also deliver at least half its input's value at the pool price before it or reverts PoorFill and is skipped; a mint's exact-output residual buy is exempt from both, so its shortfall is charged at the pool price and mint stays open; the swap amount is converted with SafeCast; mint refuses minShares above shares before any buy. Unchanged: the 0.50% fee on mints and on redeemToImd's IMD proceeds into feeImd (which pays only the 0.5 IMD oracle price and the 0.25 IMD caller rewards); redeem pays 99.50% of the proportional holdings in kind (100% when the supply reaches zero) and the 0.50% stays in held and idleImd with the remaining holders, crediting nothing to feeImd; idleImd, redeem in kind with failed transfers recorded as owed and claimable, fund, the weekly ask, the on-chain question, the 25% weight cap and the 2% price stops; held[coin] is the balance increase measured around PoolManager.take, so it always equals what really arrived. The audit of this launch's code found one low (9f216ca3) and three informational (0a7c3762, 18ca8bf9, e2325942), none medium or above; they are documented in README.md and THREAT_MODEL.md and changed no code. Compiled with solc 0.8.26, optimizer 200 runs, via_ir, cancun, bytecode_hash none; runtime 23,552 bytes, under 24,576, with no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT. Local check: forge build and forge test with the verifier fuzz seed pass (177 unit and fuzz tests; the mainnet fork tests skip without a fork URL).
